Full skill text at 5★
Deals 15 stages of DMG to enemies, each of which deals (75% of Starry Manta Ray's ATK + 18750) DMG to a random single enemy and reduces the target's Turn Meter by 5%; if the target is a Boss, increases all allies' Turn Meters by 1.5% instead and each stage of DMG also inflicts 1 layer of [Torpid] on the target for 1 turn ([Torpid]: each layer reduces the Turn Meter Increase effect by 20% and Effect RES by 12%, up to 4 layers.). At the end of the attack, Starry Manta Ray has a 100% chance to inflict [Forcefully Imprison] on the target with 3 layers of [Torpid] for 1 turn. This effect has an extra 180% Effect Hit and [Forcefully Imprison] inflicted on targets with 4 layers of [Torpid] cannot be blocked. After units of the both sides act for 2 turns in total, [Forcefully Imprison] will be converted into [Imprison]. [Forcefully Imprison]: Control Debuff, considered as [Imprison]. Cannot gain extra Turn Meter or act immediately, SPD is reduced to 1 and cannot pursue and attack/counterattack/cast extra skills.
Source: game files.

How to obtain

Free-to-play
  • Guild Store — Selection chest: 10 Souls for 20,000 Guild Coins. Limit 1; store refreshes every 30 days.
  • Elemental Market — Selection chest: 10 Souls. Limit 1; store refreshes every 30 days.
  • Homestead Market — Selection chest: 10 Souls for 100,000 Homestead Coins. Limit 1; store refreshes every 30 days.
  • Hero Quests — Selection chest of 5 Souls at 1,100 quest points.
  • Spirit Beast Cultivation — limited-time event. Free track: 10 Souls (random chance); a paid track is also available.
  • Hire Store — can be hired temporarily (not kept).
Paid
  • Monthly Card — every 7 days of claimed rewards: Soul of Spirit Beast Selection Chest (pick 1 Soul of this Spirit Beast).
  • Battle Order — Level 50 paid track: selection chest of 10 Souls.
  • Group Benefit — Selection chest of 5 Souls at 200 progress (plus Random Spirit Beast Shards at 40 and 80 progress).
  • Advanced Combat Pass — Selection chest of 10 Souls each season.
  • Huge Discount — Ultimate Pack: selection chest of 50 Souls.
